findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：2025 年無單一客戶占合併銷售超過 2%（客戶高度分散，無「最大客戶」可導入第二供應商或自製）；供應商無單一超過 8%
findings.excerpt: No single customer accounted for more than 2% of the company's 2025 consolidated sales.

findings.claim: 10-K 描述：多數客戶要求的交期或量，通常無法直接向原廠取得；經查未見 2026 年有客戶導入第二供應商或自製的申報或報導
findings.excerpt: Most of the company’s customers require delivery of their orders on schedules or volumes that are generally not available directly from manufacturers.

customer_second_source.note: 第三方分析稱 TI、ADI 擴大直接服務大型 OEM，但數字無來源，不採用。
